name: Ramadan Series
desc: Egyptian and Arab TV series from the Ramadan season, from Raafat El Haggan to Al Hashashin.

100: Which classic spy series stars Mahmoud Abdel Aziz as an Egyptian agent living undercover in Israel?
Raafat El Haggan (رأفت الهجان)
Which 2020 Peter Mimi series stars Amir Karara and Ahmed El Awady as army commandos?
Al Ekhtiyar (الاختيار)
Which Ahmed Mekky comedy follows the mayor of the village of El Mazareeta?
El Kabeer Awi (الكبير أوي)
Which 2024 series stars Karim Abdel Aziz as Hassan al-Sabbah, leader of a secret sect?
Al Hashashin (الحشاشين)
Which 2016 Mohamed Ramadan series follows law graduate Nasser El Desouky?
Al Ostoura (الأسطورة)
Which 2023 series stars Mohamed Ramadan alongside Zeina, Hala Sedki and Mai Kassab?
Gaafar El Omda (جعفر العمدة)
Which Syrian series, set in an old Damascus quarter, made 'Abu Issam' a household name?
Bab El Hara (باب الحارة)
What were the Ramadan riddle shows that made Nelly and Sherihan stars called?
Fawazeer Ramadan (فوازير رمضان)
Which epic series follows Selim El Badry and Soliman Ghanem from King Farouk's time to the '90s?
Layali El Helmeya (ليالي الحلمية)
Which puppet show, first made in 1983 with Younes Shalaby voicing its hero, was a Ramadan nights staple for Egyptian kids?
Bougy w Tamtam (بوجي وطمطم)
200: Which 2015 series stars Nelly Karim as a woman fighting drug addiction?
Taht El Saytara (تحت السيطرة)
Which 2014 series follows Nelly Karim, Ruby and others inside a women's prison?
Segn El Nesa (سجن النسا)
Which 2020 Mohamed Ramadan series follows Radwan, a mechanic sent to prison by his six greedy siblings?
Al Prince (البرنس)
Which 2021 series stars Hamada Helal, Nesreen Tafesh and Khaled Sarhan?
Al Maddah (المداح)
Which Amir Karara series follows police officer Selim El Ansary?
Kalabsh (كلبش)
Which 2016 sitcom stars Donia and Amy Samir Ghanem as a rich cousin and a poor cousin?
Nelly w Sherihan (نيللي وشريهان)
Which 2012 Adel Imam series follows a former officer who plans a bank robbery in Israel?
Ferqet Naji Atallah (فرقة ناجي عطا الله)
Which Waheed Hamed series tells the story of the Muslim Brotherhood and Hassan al-Banna?
El Gamaa (الجماعة)
Which 2022 series is set on an island visited by the mysterious strangers Khaldoun and El Ayqa?
Gezeeret Ghamam (جزيرة غمام)
Which 2021 Upper Egypt revenge series by Mohamed Sami starred Ahmed El Sakka and Amir Karara?
Nasl El Aghrab (نسل الأغراب)
300: Raafat El Haggan is based on a real spy. What was his real name?
Refaat El Gammal (رفعت الجمال)
In Nesr El Saeed (2018), Mohamed Ramadan's officer Zein fights a Saidi businessman nicknamed what?
Hitler (هتلر)
Which 2017 Tamer Mohsen series, later on Netflix, starred Iyad Nassar and Ahmed Dawood?
Haza El Masaa (هذا المساء)
Which 2017 series, based on an Ihsan Abdel Quddous novel, has a theme song sung by Assala?
La Totfe2 El Shams (لا تطفئ الشمس)
Which 2025 series stars Amina Khalil as a teacher who uncovers that children at her school are being abused?
Lam Shamseya (لام شمسية)
In which 2024 comedy does forensic doctor Hamdy struggle to find a nanny for his twins?
Ashghal Sha2a (أشغال شقة)
Which family comedy stars Dina El Sherbiny and Sherif Salama as a cosmetic surgeon and a beauty-brand owner who fall in love?
Kamel El Adad (كامل العدد)
In which 2016 series does Yehia El Fakharany play the devil, who turns up claiming to be the family's old friend?
Wanous (ونوس)
Which 2012 Yehia El Fakharany series follows Herbert, a suicidal foreigner who finds Sufism and settles in Upper Egypt?
Al Khawaga Abdel Kader (الخواجة عبد القادر)
Which 2021 sequel stars Karim Abdel Aziz and Ahmed Mekky as police officers?
Al Ekhtiyar 2 (الاختيار 2)
400: Which Adel Imam series was held back from Ramadan 2019 and finally aired in Ramadan 2020?
Valentino (فالنتينو)
Which director made both Al Ekhtiyar and Al Hashashin?
Peter Mimi
Which director made Al Ostoura, Nasl El Aghrab and Gaafar El Omda?
Mohamed Sami
Which 2010 series follows police chief Hassan Mahfouz investigating a scandal at a celebrity wedding?
Ahl Cairo (أهل كايرو)
Which 2007 Saudi-produced series told the story of Egypt's last king?
El Malek Farouk (الملك فاروق)
Which 2012 MBC series tells the life of the caliph Omar ibn al-Khattab?
Omar (عمر)
Which 2005 series starred Abla Kamel and Somaya El Khashab as Alexandria's serial-killer sisters?
Raya w Sakina (ريا وسكينة)
Which 2015 series starring Menna Shalaby and Iyad Nassar is set in Cairo's Jewish quarter from 1948?
Haret El Yahud (حارة اليهود)
Which 2012 series starred Mahmoud Abdel Aziz as an Arabic teacher who leaves his old Cairo neighbourhood to work abroad?
Bab El Khalq (باب الخلق)
Which 2014 Yehia El Fakharany series retells King Lear in Upper Egypt?
Dahsha (دهشة)
500: Al Ekhtiyar's hero, Ahmed El Mansi, commanded which commando battalion?
In Al Hashashin, Hassan al-Sabbah rules from which mountain fortress?
Segn El Nesa is based on a work by which writer?
Which writer is behind Al Khawaga Abdel Kader, Dahsha, Wanous, Gezeeret Ghamam and Al Hashashin?
Which director made Taht El Saytara and Haza El Masaa?
Who created and directed the puppet show Bougy w Tamtam?
Who played Hitler, the villain of Nesr El Saeed?
Before settling on Wanous, what was the series first going to be called?
For how many Ramadans in a row did Kalabsh air, starting in 2017?
